400.message: Bad Request -- Your request is invalid.

401.message: Unauthorized -- Your API key is wrong.

403.message: Forbidden -- The id requested is hidden for administrators only.

404.message: Not Found -- The specified id could not be found.

405.message: Method Not Allowed -- You tried to access a id with an invalid method.

406.message: Not Acceptable -- You requested a format that isn't json.

410.message: Gone -- The id requested has been removed from our servers.

429.message: Too Many Requests -- You're requesting too many ids! Slow down!.

500.message: Internal Server Error -- We had a problem with our server. Try again later.

503.message: Service Unavailable -- We're temporarily offline for maintenance. Please try again later.
